dogecoin.text: @BartBaker @elonmusk @PolyDoge Your fault for holding a crypto like Dogecoin long term. It should have been a good short term trade, nothing more. Take responsibility for your actions instead of blaming others.

So it's @elonmusk fault so many folks didn't do any research before putting their money on the line investing in #Bitcoin or #dogecoin? This is a good lesson recognizing pump & dumps. Ride the wave, day trade, but don't hold a highly volatile asset if your risk tolerance is low.
